name: Kamisunagawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kamisunagawa town emblem in navy and red: a navy lozenge crossed by thin diagonal lines, bearing the characters 上砂 in white and red.
history: Municipal flag of Kamisunagawa, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1953.

features.role: Kamisunagawa town emblem — a navy lozenge crossed by thin diagonal lines, bearing the characters 上砂 in white and red
